build_kneighbors_graph: build a sparse connectivity graph of k nearest neighbors for points in X with mode distance
build_radius_neighbors_graph: build a sparse connectivity graph of neighbors within a given radius from points in X
create_KNeighborsTransformer: create a sklearn transformer that converts data into a k-nearest neighbors sparse graph
create_RadiusNeighborsTransformer: create a sklearn transformer that converts data into a radius-based neighbors sparse graph
test_kneighbors_graph: test the kneighbors_graph function with sample data and connectivity mode
